pages.title: Planets
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Four worlds to land on: the **Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus**. Mars, Mercury and Venus also have an orbit dimension; the Moon has none.
- Titanium ore is on all four; tungsten only on Mercury.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Temperatures run from -270 C in orbit to 464 C on Venus.

Northstar models many bodies, but only four have a surface to land on: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. Each has a surface. Earth, Mars, Mercury and Venus also have an orbit dimension above them; the Moon has none. The rest are sky scenery in the atlas.

pages.title: The numbers
pages.text:
Gravity, temperature, air:
- Moon 1.6, -183 C, none
- Mars 3.71, -100 C, thin
- Mercury 3.7, -200 to 434 C, none
- Venus 8.87, 464 C, dense\
Orbits: no gravity, -270 C

pages.title: The Moon
pages.text:
Lunar Plains, hills, crater fields and caves of ice, glowstone and asurine.

- **Ores:** titanium, zinc, copper, iron, gold, diamond, redstone, lapis, glowstone.
- **Mobs:** Moon Eel, Lunargrade, Snail.

Abandoned lunar bases can be explored.

pages.title: Moon Titanium Ore
pages.text: Smelt it directly into a Titanium Ingot. Titanium ore appears on all four worlds.

pages.title: Mars
pages.text:
Martian dunes, highlands, peaks and caverns with crimsite and overgrown plants.

- **Ores:** titanium, iron, copper, zinc, gold, diamond, quartz, redstone.
- **Mobs:** Cobra, Devil Moth, Root Toad, Echo Worm.

Martian iron and ash make [#](2E5AAC)[Martian steel](entry://space/space_materials)[#]().

pages.title: Mars Titanium Ore
pages.text: Mars also has palms, tulips and Martian strawberry bushes.

pages.title: Mercury
pages.text:
Hills, basins, and icy or magmatic caverns, with a huge swing between day and night.

- **Ores:** the only world with **tungsten** ore. Also titanium, glowstone, lapis, gold, diamond.
- **Mobs:** Mercurian Raptor, Roach, Tortoise.

pages.title: Mercury Tungsten Ore
pages.text: The only source of tungsten. Crushed raw tungsten is [#](7A3C9A)[washed](entry://glossary/washing)[#]() into nuggets.

pages.title: Venus
pages.text:
Fungal forests, lava and sulfuric caverns under a very dense atmosphere.

- **Ores:** coal, quartz, glowstone, titanium and others.
- **Mobs:** Mimic, Scorpion, Stone Bull, Vulture.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** iron suits burn here; wear [#](2E5AAC)[Martian steel](entry://space/space_survival)[#](). Sulfuric Acid kills swimmers.

pages.title: Venus Gravel
pages.text: Crushing it gives the most Rutile Concentrate of any source, for making titanium on Earth.
